subject: What is still difficult to source?
preheader: An unresolved item, a trial to organise or several equipment decisions that belong together.
intro: A specified item can be only one part of an equipment request. There may also be a trial to arrange, an access constraint to check or another piece of equipment that changes the answer.
If you have a brief like that in progress, I would welcome the chance to pick it up with you.
sectionTitle: Start with the part that is unresolved
body: Supply Ministry helps with cross-category assistive-technology sourcing and coordination. We can discuss an individual requirement or look at how several items need to fit the same functional brief.

Tell us what has already been specified, what is difficult to organise and any practical constraints on the setup. That gives us a useful basis for checking options, trial arrangements and the information needed for a quote.
There is no need to turn an unfinished question into a polished shopping list before getting in touch. Your clinical direction stays central as the equipment details are worked through.
actionTitle: One practical brief is enough to reconnect
actionText: Reply with a few de-identified lines about the requirement or the sticking point. We can start there and identify what needs checking next.
